rows.en: Obtained "Kujaku Candroid".
Looks like this is the treasure Gaoh was hoarding. Perfect. We'll put it to good use.
Completed the quest "The Evil Grand Bandit Gang Returns!".
The supposedly defeated Mezool and Gamel were sighted. Take OOO to SW Ultra Cube Layer 2.
If I remember right, the report said it was around here.
Oh my? Isn't that Ankh? And OOO, that little boy?
They came! Ankh and OOO, they came!
Gamel! Mezool!! So you really did come back!!
What's going on!? We definitely beat them back then...
I'm the one who brought them back.
Uva...! What are you playing at!!
After I lost the Regis Fight...
I secretly used Waste Yummies to make Cell Medals and built up my strength,
then used the Core Medals I'd collected to revive Mezool and Gamel...
All so I could be sure of taking your Core Medals!!
Now then, little OOO boy. I'll be taking those Medals back.
Medals make Mezool happy. I take Medals.
Tch. Pretty clever thinking, for Uva.
OOO!! Let's go!
Yeah, I know!
Ugh...!! No way... This can't be...!!
What's wrong, Uva? For all your big talk, that was over pretty fast, huh?
...I won't forget this.
Tch!
You sure about this, Ankh? Just letting him go like that?
Don't worry. He's got no power left.
Completed the quest "Return of the Greeed".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
Dummy
Reports just came in of Nemos fighting each other in Begins Cube. Rush there and find the cause.

notes.note: Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36, Quest024.bla +206; script maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1, checked +186/+202 Ankh = 187/203). 'Yuukou ni tsukawasete morau' rendered with 'we' (the team).
Quest-board description (not played by Quest025.bla); wording and 'Ultra Cube Layer 2' follow the shipped QuestMess 0.76, which adds 'ring room'. Southwest abbreviated SW to fit the box.

Quest025.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (checked against content and empty rows 2/3/5/8/12/18-20/26-27/31-32/36-38). Speakers: 4/9/13/23/24/29/33/35 Ankh (36); 10/25/34 OOO (5); 6/7/11 shown as '???' (CHARA 30) but voiced as Mezool/Gamel/Uva by content; 14-17/28/30 Uva (47); 21 Mezool (90); 22 Gamel (124).
Mezool's 'bouya' for OOO (Eiji) rendered 'little boy' (also in 21), keeping her motherly-condescending tone.
Gamel's childlike broken speech kept broken; 'morau' = Gamel taking the Medals, so 'I take Medals'.
Ankh calls him 'OOO' here as in the source (not 'Eiji').
Ankh (CHARA 36, +32) clicking his tongue after Uva flees.

QuestEventMess001.mbb is byte-identical in Japanese to DG_QUEST001_pk (all 177 rows); every row here reuses the English of the same id from quest_001.en.json, including its speaker work (Quest001.bla Pt_Chara_Check order: Zeta, Nu, Zero, W (Shotaro), OOO, Mebius, Den-O Sword, 00, Wing Zero, Black RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, Seven, God Gundam, Taro).
Says Nemo while the shipped QuestMess says GM II; kept as written (same as DG_QUEST001_pk 0.5).
Unused row; voiced as Ankh as in quest_001 (uncertain there too).

report: 80/80 rows examined. DG_QUEST024 tail and DG_QUEST025 speakers from Quest024/025.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N+1). QuestEventMess001.mbb rows are identical to DG_QUEST001_pk and reuse quest_001 English verbatim. Mezool's 'bouya' as 'little boy'. No new names.
